name: Cave-In
disable: DC 28 Crafting check (expert) or DC 31 Survival check (trained) to prop up the cavern ceiling without triggering a collapse.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves the rubble

---

Effect The cavern collapses in a cave-in that deals 4d8+22 bludgeoning damage to the triggering creature and all creatures in the cavern (DC 30 basic Reflex save save).

text: The rubble shifts and the cavern ceiling collapses.
